'''Megumi Toyoguchi''' (Japanese: '''豊口めぐみ''' ''Toyoguchi Megumi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.  

==Biography==
Toyoguchi was born on January 2, 1978 in {{wp|Machida, Tokyo|Machida}}, {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during the [[original series]] and started out voicing various [[Character of the day|characters of the day]], doing so all the way into {{aniseries|RS}}. Toyoguchi's most prominent role came during {{aniseries|DP}}, where she voiced {{an|Dawn}}, one of {{ashfr|Ash's traveling partners}}. In 2016, it was revealed that she is married and pregnant. In 2017, she gave birth to a baby son. Toyoguchi is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}}.
